basic_info.description: Experience breathtaking, ever-changing views of the San Francisco Bay from this residence in Russian Hills premier waterfront location. This studio, ideal as a starter home or pied-a-terre, offers stunning wood floors, ample closet space, and a private balcony where youll enjoy uninterrupted views of Alcatraz and the bay throughout the day. The north-facing wall of glass floods the home with natural light and provides seamless access to the balcony. Completing the home is a ground-level parking spot and additional storage. Fontana East, a luxurious mid-century modern building built in 1965, offers excellent amenities, including a conference room with a kitchen, a ground-floor garden with BBQ facilities, and on-site management. Monthly HOA dues cover Cable TV, Internet, electricity, heat, water, trash, sewer, common area maintenance, and doorperson services. Dont miss this opportunity to enjoy timeless views at an unbeatable value!
